title: After downloading or importing a plugin from the `Asset Store`, the file list shows hidden `.uid` and `.import` files
body: ### Tested versions v4.8.dev4.official [b56a91878] v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf] ### System information Godot v4.8.dev4 - macOS Sequoia (15.7.5) - Multi-window, 1 monitor (2940x1912 @ 60.00 Hz) - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M4 (Apple9) - Apple M4 (10 threads) - 16.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description If this issue is already reported in some other form, please tell me! from `4.7.2.stable` It doesn't really make sense for these to show up in Godot because they're supposed to be together (and theoretically one file and concept like other resources are). It's invisible in the File Manager already, so it should be here, too. So including a `.gd` file should automatically import its `.uid` file (and unchecking it should exclude its UID file too). If you import a script without the UID, paths will break. Less catastrophically, importing a UID without the script will clutter your project. In the same vein, `.import` files should not show up, either. They should automatically be included or excluded if its corresponding resource is, too. Background: I was working on updating the **Installing Plugins** doc page. I'll post a PR for it when this is fixed, since I don't want to include an outdated screenshot containing these hidden files lol. ### Steps to reproduce Download any plugin from the Asset Store that contains a script or texture and import it. It should show the file list containing `.uid` and/or `.import` files. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Idk if a MRP can help since this is dependent on downloading a plugin. Instead, I will upload a minimal plugin which you can import into Godot using the **Import** button in the Asset Store tab. [minimalplugin.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31812020/minimalplugin.zip)
